projects.title: SmarTown 3D GIS
projects.description: Web GIS platform for 2D and 3D map studies, spatial analytics, and asset intelligence.
projects.longDescription: SmarTown 3D GIS is a comprehensive geospatial intelligence platform designed for municipal asset management, infrastructure planning, and advanced spatial analytics. Built to handle massive geospatial datasets, the system renders highly performant 2D vector layers and rich 3D digital twins in real time. It enables engineers, planners, and decision-makers to visualize spatial relationships, query infrastructure attributes, and perform site-suitability analysis directly in the browser.
features: Interactive 3D digital twins with detailed mesh and terrain modeling.
Real-time asset intelligence and utility network mapping.
Advanced spatial querying (buffers, intersections, and proximity tools).
Performant rendering of massive point cloud and 3D tiles datasets.
Integrated geospatial workflows for municipal reporting and planning.

projects.title: KESMA — قسمة
projects.description: GIS workbench to visualize, divide and compare land-division scenarios for inherited or jointly owned land.
projects.longDescription: KESMA (قسمة) is a client-side GIS workbench built to transform contentious land-division negotiations into transparent, measurable decision-support workflows. Designed for co-owners and heirs, the platform models exact fractional inheritance shares (farāʾiḍ), multi-criteria spatial valuation (soil value zones, fixed point assets, and road frontage access), automated parallel strip partitioning, and real-time topology-constrained vertex editing. It operates offline-first in the browser with IndexedDB persistence, multilingual support (Arabic RTL, French, English), and vector-rendered A4 print-ready PDF reports.
features: Multi-format spatial ingestion: import GeoJSON, KML/KMZ, zipped Shapefiles, GPX tracks, or CSV with projected CRS detection and reprojection.
Exact fractional share engine: computes exact fractions (1/8, 1/6, 2/3), percentages, surface targets, and residual remainder weighting.
Automated & topology-preserving partitioning: parallel strip auto-splitting by surface area or value, lot split/merge, and vertex editing constrained to property bounds.
Spatial value & access model: base rate per m², configurable multi-polygon value zones, fixed-value assets (wells, structures), and 3m+ road frontage access validation.
Side-by-side scenario comparison & reconciliation: synchronized multi-map indicator comparison, live balance vs. target tracking, and topology self-intersection checks.
Vector report generation & portable exports: browser-rendered print-ready A4 PDF reports with disclaimers, .kesma.json project files, GeoJSON, Excel (.xlsx), and CSV tables.
